review_kind: third correction: broker-owned P4 authority composition and exact capability boundary

supersedes.disposition: 0079 F5A-P4-P0-M08-constructor-selectable-trust-root is corrected by removing public concrete/dependency construction. 0075 M02-M05 and 0077 M06-M07 remain retained requirements, not reopened or weakened. Earlier evidence is append-only.

authority_and_limits.authorization: OwnerDecision 0073 grants bounded Phase 0 design authority for the sole-writer correction, including this necessary constructor/dependency correction; it grants no RED.
authority_and_limits.phase: Design only. Implementation, RED, merge, deployment, real data, replay, HPO/refit, backtest, paper/live activity, parser/CLI/compose route, and protected-data access remain disabled until a fresh independent skeptic finds zero unresolved in-scope Critical/Major.
authority_and_limits.non_claim: This defines one in-process synthetic P4 authority only. It does not claim the ADR-0123 OS-owned durable authority, restart reconstruction, cross-process locking, or closure of R23. ADR-0126's deferred multi-private-mutation development-broker attacks are not reclassified as safe behavior.

public_v1: LifecycleAuthority is the ABC with exactly produce, seal, publish, capture, open_capture.
_development_broker(...) is the existing private v1 synthetic factory and remains behaviorally/API compatible.
direct_legacy: P4 authority.capture(published, frozen, port, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonce)
P4 authority.captured_bindings(session, frozen, verified, consumer_node, transition_nonce)
inventoried_current_surface.scope_rule: LifecycleAuthority's abstract set and all ordinary v1 subclasses remain unchanged. Only a broker-issued CapturedAuthorizationAuthority capability is P4-capable; an arbitrary LifecycleAuthority subclass is never upgraded by inheritance, duck typing, a wrapper, or a facade.

public_contracts_and_composition.LifecycleAuthority: The existing public ABC is unchanged: produce, seal, publish, capture, open_capture only. No P4 abstract method is added here, so every v1 subclass remains constructible and behavior-compatible.

CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.kind: Public nonconstructible ABC/capability surface, exported beside LifecycleAuthority. It declares abstract authorize_capture_set(...) and inherits the unchanged v1 abstract set. Direct ABC construction refuses; trusted broker-only registration is required before an otherwise concrete subclass instance is accepted as a P4 authority capability.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.input: captures is an exact built-in nonempty tuple of exact built-in (published, frozen, derived_port) tuples in complete PlannedCaptureSet order; admission_ref is exact built-in IssuanceBasisRef.v1 for action-execution-admission or final-replay-admission; all run, SHA-256, identity, cardinality, ordering, duplicate, live-head, and nonce rules remain closed. There is no constructor or per-call signer, keyring, resolver, clock, revocation source, contract, ledger/store, lock, callback, factory, provider, path, URL, session, artifact bytes, or override parameter.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.output: CapturedAuthorizationRecord and LaunchSession(kind='captured-authorization-v2') are opaque, identity-bound, nonmapping, noncopyable, nonpickleable, and expose no bytes, member/provider, signer, resolver, store, lock, dependency, or construction capability. P4 creates no _Captured, VerifiedCapture, or CapturedBindings capability.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.broker_issued_exactness: The ABC owns a private issuance attestation: only the authority broker can register an exact final concrete instance during construction. P4 entry checks both exact registered object identity and exact final class identity before class-bound dispatch. isinstance alone is insufficient. Registration, final class, attestation, and dependency graph are private and have no public mutation, serialization, or reconstruction API.

public_contracts_and_composition.external_real_authority: The real external concrete authority is broker-owned and outside caller construction. It alone may implement the public ABC in a deployment-capable environment; its composition root, trust roots, OS-owned WORM ledger, locks, signer/keyring, clock, resolver, and revocation source are not a library caller API. This in-repo design neither provides nor emulates public construction of that concrete authority.

synthetic_private_authority.kind: _SyntheticP4CapturedAuthorizationAuthority is a private exact final CapturedAuthorizationAuthority implementation, permanently deployment_eligible=false. It is not in __all__, cannot be instantiated without a private one-shot factory token, has no subclass extension point, and refuses direct construction/copy/deepcopy/pickle/reduce/state/mapping reconstruction.
synthetic_private_authority.sole_factory: _development_p4_broker(*, fixture_facts=None) is one new private test-only factory, distinct from and not a replacement for _development_broker v1. It accepts no dependency object, class, wrapper, callback, store, lock, signer, keyring, resolver, clock, revocation authority, contract, session, or per-call dependency override. It constructs the full exact graph once, registers the returned exact public-ABC capability, and returns it typed only as CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.
exact_final_graph: _LifecycleAuthorizationLedger and its one capture-transition lock domain
synthetic_private_authority.factory_fixture_data: fixture_facts is hostile data, not authority selection. The factory first requires an exact closed built-in mapping/list/bytes grammar, recursively copies/canonicalizes it, rejects aliases, subclasses, callables, objects, mappings with unknown keys, paths, URLs, stores, handles, and noncanonical values, then loads only copied validated facts through _FixedWormTrustedArtifactResolver.load_fixture_facts. The resolver exposes no replace/delete/mutate/generation-select API after factory completion. Fixture facts may make canonical verification pass or fail but cannot choose code, a trust root, key material, signature policy, clock, revocation policy, resolver implementation, ledger, or lock.
synthetic_private_authority.legacy_compatibility: _development_broker(...) remains the v1 factory with its exact existing signature and test behavior. It neither returns P4 capability nor accepts a P4 opt-in. P4 tests use only the distinct private factory; a fixed opt-in flag is prohibited unless it has precisely the same no-dependency/no-trust-selection property and preserves the v1 factory signature.

private_held_dependencies.contract: _FixedCapturedAuthorizationContract has only prepare_batch(snapshot, captures, admission_ref, runtime) and verify_prepared_batch(snapshot, prepared_batch). It has no admission reserve/consume/abort, ledger/lock/write/lookup, session/event construction, member/provider open, import, construction, execution, output, callback, or hidden spend capability.
private_held_dependencies.resolver: The fixed WORM resolver returns one immutable internally selected snapshot and recursively resolves the selected admission, each signed artifact, IssuanceBasis.v1, and exact reference. It closes canonical grammar, named self, SHA-256, Ed25519, role/use, trusted time, revocation, exact basis/ref kind set, cycles, future output, and action/replay adjacency. No caller supplies bytes except copied fixture facts, a snapshot generation, path, URL, fallback, store, resolver, callback, or trust root.
private_held_dependencies.dependency_integrity: Each authority operation verifies exact private dependency identities/classes and immutable construction commitments before use; dependencies hold copied frozen state only. Dependency attributes are write-locked, aliases never escape factory/authority scope, and no getter returns a dependency, callable, internal table, lock, store, signer, or resolver. A mismatch, missing attestation, altered commitment, altered final dispatch capsule, or unexpected result type refuses before preparation or ledger entry.

HistoricalStudyVerifier.constructor: HistoricalStudyVerifier(authority) accepts only an already broker-issued exact CapturedAuthorizationAuthority capability. It performs private issuance attestation, exact final-class/identity validation, and stores one identity pin. It does not construct a P4 authority or accept/forward/inject any P4 dependency, fixture, factory, callback, signer, resolver, clock, revocation authority, ledger, store, or lock.
HistoricalStudyVerifier.method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
HistoricalStudyVerifier.delegation: At call time it rechecks the stored object, broker attestation, exact class, and class-owned authorize_capture_set implementation, then invokes the exact bound class method. An instance attribute, subclass override, monkeypatched facade method, wrapper, duck object, copied/reconstructed verifier, or swapped authority refuses. The verifier owns no P4 ledger/state/lock/admission/receipt/session/event write. Its legacy capture remains the existing route but participates in shared authority lock/state arbitration.

HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.constructor: HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver(verifier) accepts only one exact, unmodified, identity-pinned HistoricalStudyVerifier that already holds an accepted broker-issued authority. It cannot construct the verifier or accept any authority/dependency separately.
HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.delegation: At call time it rechecks exact verifier identity/class and invokes HistoricalStudyVerifier's exact class method; wrapper, subclass, duck, copy, pickle, state reconstruction, attribute swap, and monkeypatched callable paths refuse. It owns no P4 state, dependency, lock, ledger, admission, receipt, session, or event.

M08_dependency_attack_disposition.constructor_and_factory: Public concrete construction is eliminated. ABC construction, unissued subclass instance, private-final direct construction, foreign factory, factory parameter injection, keyword/positional aliasing, factory return wrapping, and alternate factory use cannot produce an accepted P4 capability.
M08_dependency_attack_disposition.alias_subclass_duck_wrapper: Exact object and exact final class are checked at authority, verifier, and driver construction and again before every delegation/commit. ABC subclasses, subclasses of private finals, objects satisfying methods, proxy/wrapper/decorator objects, __getattr__ forwarding, bound-method substitution, and object aliases outside the identity pin refuse. An alias to the one legitimate issued authority is only the same capability, not a second authority or replacement dependency; it still serializes on its one ledger-lock domain.
M08_dependency_attack_disposition.copy_pickle_state: Authority, record, session, verifier, driver, factory token, prepared batch, attestation, and private dependency types refuse copy/deepcopy/pickle/reduce/getstate/setstate. Constructors validate only factory-created private tokens and never deserialize state. A reconstructed mapping/dict/slots object cannot acquire broker attestation or exact identity registration.
M08_dependency_attack_disposition.held_dependency_replacement: No dependency is caller-provided or externally returned. Replacing a held signer/keyring/resolver/clock/revocation/contract/ledger/lock object, internal table, factory token, attestation, or dispatch capsule breaks the identity/commitment check and refuses before effects. The one ledger owns both P4 and legacy arbitration; a caller cannot provide a substitute ledger/lock domain.
M08_dependency_attack_disposition.callable_monkeypatch_and_ADR0126: The synthetic graph invokes only private fixed final dispatch captured at factory construction, checks result type/commitments at each boundary, and has no caller-injected callable. A single monkeypatch of a public method, module name, instance method, dependency method, resolver result, or facade callable must fail closed or leave no authority effect; RED covers each. A development-broker holder controlling the interpreter can still coordinate multiple private rewrites/closure-cell or object.__setattr__ attacks; those are expressly deferred multi-private-mutation attacks in ADR-0126, not a basis to expose a new public trust-selection seam. A single-surface mutation that creates a P4 record/session remains in scope and must refuse.
M08_dependency_attack_disposition.M08_result: A caller can submit hostile data only through the closed fixture loader or ordinary authorize request grammar. It cannot select authority code, trust roots, resolver/key/revocation policy, contract output, ledger, lock, or session construction. M04 trust closure and M06/M07 same-domain arbitration therefore remain caller-unselectable.

ledger_states_and_same_domain_transactio.ledger: _LifecycleAuthorizationLedger is private, authority-owned, in-process transactional WORM state. Its sole mutex is the same LifecycleAuthority capture-transition lock used by all direct legacy and facade routes. One record domain contains per-live-identity head/claim, admission state, execution-key uniqueness, complete canonical P4 batch, session identity/nonce, and SessionStartRecord; there is no second admission store or cross-store coordination.
methods: commit_p4_batch(*, live_identities, expected_published_heads, admission_identity, execution_key, prepared_batch, session_decision) -> _P4Committed | _P4Refused | _P4OutcomeUnknown

states.execution_key: canonical (study_id, canonical execution_authority_ref bytes, logical_execution_id, run_id)

invariants: Only PUBLISHED is admissible to either route; private transient states are not observable records.
CAPTURED_V1 and P4_COMMITTED are terminal for matched live identity within this authority instance.
Admission has no Reserved/Aborted authoritative state: UNUSED before one commit and COMMITTED forever afterward in this process.

Committed WORM value contains consumed admission, ordered ports, ordered receipts, set, replay evidence or action-none, verified SessionDecision, session identity/nonce, SessionStartRecord, and frozen live projection.
ledger_states_and_same_domain_transactio.legacy: Validate outside and inside shared lock; atomically transition PUBLISHED to LEGACY_COMMITTING to CAPTURED_V1 while appending v1 receipt, binding/interning legacy session, and recording its sole start identity. Later P4 sees CAPTURED_V1 and refuses before P4 reservation/batch/session/admission effect.
ledger_states_and_same_domain_transactio.p4: Obtain fixed resolver snapshot; contract prepare_batch and verify_prepared_batch before ledger entry have no authority effect. Under one lock recheck exact PUBLISHED heads, unused nonces/admission, absent key, dependency commitments, fixed snapshot, complete field adjacency, and frozen projection; mark lock-private P4_RESERVING. The one logical commit first consumes admission in immutable record, then publishes/mints complete verified port/receipt/set/replay batch plus session identity and SessionStartRecord, then transitions every identity to P4_COMMITTED without releasing lock.
ledger_states_and_same_domain_transactio.failure_and_unknown: Preparation/verification/dependency/fixture/trust failure leaves heads PUBLISHED and admission UNUSED. Precommit failure discards only reservation and destroys prepared data; retry is legal. commit_p4_batch publishes one complete record or nothing. An uncertain post-boundary caller resolves exact key/admission before any remint; committed resolve returns same identity only and never aborts/rolls back consumption.
ledger_states_and_same_domain_transactio.post_p4_denials: For P4_RESERVING/P4_COMMITTED, every listed direct legacy/facade capture/open/bind/member/consume/release route refuses through same lock/state before receipt, session, member/provider, import, construction, execution, output, or release effect. Helpers cannot manufacture P4 state. Ordinary unrelated v1 capture remains positive.

ADR0125_closure_retained.prepared_is_not_issued: _PreparedCapturedAuthorizationBatch is private, nonexportable, nonserializable, authority-local, and inaccessible by bytes/dict/pickle/lookup/store/key/session/member APIs. Candidate signing is preparation, not issuance. Only same-ledger commit publication gives authority, binds admission/key/session, and makes complete batch resolvable; no signed-and-issued port exists before consumption.
ADR0125_closure_retained.basis_closure: Fixed caller-unselectable resolver snapshot recursively validates every selected signed artifact and exact basis/ref. P(CES)==P(BVP)==P(CAS)==P(StageAdmission or FinalReplayEntry)==ordered PlannedCaptureSet==ordered live captures by complete PCE bytes/cardinality.
artifact_adjacency: Each PCE has exactly one v2 port and v2 receipt; receipt binds PCE/port, predecessor publication schema/digest, stream sequence/predecessor, consumer kind/id, runtime digest, and WORM-unique nonce.

Set/replay evidence are strict planned-entry-order projections; action carries action-none replay evidence, replay requires exact FinalManifest/FinalReplayAdmission/FinalReplayEntry/intent and issued ports equal set triples.
Session decision matches study, execution authority ref, logical execution, run, document, BVP, set self, process measurement, purpose, time, and committed live identities.
ADR0125_closure_retained.session_start: Session identity/nonce and canonical SessionStartRecord are fields of same committed record. Postcommit opaque interning/return has no authority effect; intern failure resolves existing record and cannot create another session/event.

M08_constructor_factory_dependency.schedule: Attempt public ABC construction, ABC subclass/foreign concrete construction, direct private-final construction, old v1 factory P4 opt-in, alternate factory, and every positional/keyword dependency argument (contract, signer, keyring, resolver, clock, revocation, ledger/store, lock, callback, factory, provider).
M08_constructor_factory_dependency.assert: All refuse; only _development_p4_broker with hostile fixture facts returns one deployment_eligible=false exact public-ABC capability; _development_broker v1 remains unchanged and non-P4.

M08_constructor_factory_dependency.schedule: Pass fixture facts containing aliases, subclasses, Mapping/Sequence impostors, callables, wrapper objects, unknown keys, paths/URLs, mutable stores, prebuilt artifacts, noncanonical bytes, and mutate original facts after construction.
M08_constructor_factory_dependency.assert: Closed copying/validation refuses invalid inputs; valid facts are independently copied into fixed WORM resolver, post-return mutation cannot change snapshot/trust, and no fact selects code/key/trust root/resolver/ledger/lock.

M08_constructor_factory_dependency.schedule: Give verifier/driver exact issued authority, alias to it, ABC subclass, private-final subclass attempt, duck, wrapper/proxy/decorator, stale/copy/pickle/state-rebuilt object, and swapped authority/verifier attributes.
M08_constructor_factory_dependency.assert: Only exact broker-issued identity is accepted; alias has same domain, all substitutes/reforged state refuse; verifier/driver class-bound delegation invokes only pinned exact implementation and creates no dependency/writer state.

M08_constructor_factory_dependency.schedule: Attempt held signer/keyring/resolver/clock/revocation/contract/ledger/lock/attestation/dispatch/internal-table replacement and monkeypatch each public/facade/dependency callable or resolver result one at a time, before prepare, under reservation, and before commit.
M08_constructor_factory_dependency.assert: Every single-surface alteration refuses before P4 artifact/session/admission/legacy effect or leaves no effect; tests document ADR-0126 multi-private coordinated rewrites as deferred rather than passing them as authority.

M08_constructor_factory_dependency.schedule: copy/deepcopy/pickle/reduce/getstate/setstate every authority, factory token, dependency, prepared batch, record, session, verifier, driver; construct dict/slots lookalikes and use object aliases.
M08_constructor_factory_dependency.assert: Serialization/reconstruction refuses, lookalikes never receive issuance attestation, and alias cannot replace held dependency or create second ledger/lock domain.

M06_schedules.schedule: Legacy direct capture commits v1 under shared transition lock, then direct P4 enters.
M06_schedules.assert: P4 refuses at locked PUBLISHED comparison; no P4 reservation/batch/session-start/admission mutation.

M06_schedules.schedule: P4 holds P4_RESERVING before commit while direct legacy, verifier.capture, and driver.capture contend.
M06_schedules.assert: All block/refuse through same lock; no v1 receipt/session; resume commits only complete P4 batch.

M06_schedules.schedule: After P4 commit invoke every direct/verifier/driver legacy capture/open/bind/member/read/require/consume/release route on matched identities.
M06_schedules.assert: Each refuses before legacy/member/provider/import/construct/run/output/release effect; unrelated v1 stays positive.

M06_schedules.schedule: Barrier-race shared identity with differing P4 keys/admissions, same key/admission, and legacy versus P4 repeatedly.
M06_schedules.assert: Exactly one complete winner; no check-then-act, mixed history, duplicate session, or partial effect.

M07_and_ADR0125.schedule: Cause resolver/canonical/signature/basis/time/revocation/contract prepare or verify failure; retry corrected input.
M07_and_ADR0125.assert: No authority artifact/session/event/lookup; UNUSED admission and PUBLISHED heads; retry succeeds.

M07_and_ADR0125.schedule: Probe prepared candidates for bytes/dict/pickle/lookup/store/key/session/member access; fail receipt/set/replay/revalidation during reservation.
M07_and_ADR0125.assert: No access or issuance; reservation clears and admission remains UNUSED.

M07_and_ADR0125.schedule: Spy precommit and postpublish fault boundaries then resolve exact key/admission.
M07_and_ADR0125.assert: Before has no record/consumption; after has one record ordering consumption before complete batch/session start; resolve never remints/aborts/rolls back.

M07_and_ADR0125.schedule: Concurrent same admission/key contenders and action/replay one/multi-PCE positive cases with every field/self/preimage/order/adjacency mutation.
M07_and_ADR0125.assert: One serialized same-ledger WORM commit; exact complete batch only; no second session/event or cross-store split.

retained: Exact public signatures and all opaque mapping/subclass/duck/wrapper/internal-table refusals.

No import/open/construct/run/output/release effects; Packet 3 and ordinary-v1 positives in tests/pipeline/test_trust.py, tests/production/test_capture_lifecycle.py, and tests/production/test_adr0125_preflight.py remain.
